EU-wide picture
  • 75% of Member States have neither designated nor certified an HNO.
  • 38% of hydrogen projects in the draft EU TYNDP 2026 appear in national plans (33% in 2024).
  • 14 Member States include repurposing or decommissioning projects in their NDPs (8 in 2024).

ACER covers transmission-level plans (TSOs and HNOs); the Ready4H2 examples cover distribution. Data collected April–May 2026, before the 5 August 2026 transposition deadline.

NL · De-risking & cost allocation

The Netherlands

Pooling expertise for early hydrogen network development
First draft law
Covered in overviewDraft
DraftAdoptedIn force
Basis: The Netherlands example appears under de-risking and cost-allocation measures; the first draft law pools early hydrogen project development at regional DSO level.
  • Regional network operators would jointly learn and bundle efforts while distribution-level hydrogen remains limited.
  • The organisation would prepare, develop and implement hydrogen projects.
  • Completed projects would be transferred to the individual network operators.
ACER finding

One of four countries with hydrogen pipelines already connecting industrial sites. Scenarios run to 2050 and project costs are public.

National approaches to Gas Package implementation

Illustrative examples from the Ready4H2 overview · 30 September 2026

DK · Political agreement · hydrogen infrastructure economic framework

Denmark

The political agreement allows tariff-revenue deferral to reduce early-user costs and incentives for long-term user commitments.

NL · First draft law

The Netherlands

A central hydrogen distribution organisation is being designed at regional-network-operator level to pool expertise and develop early projects.

FR · Biomethane right-to-inject framework · since 2018

France

A mature biomethane framework combines territorial connection planning, tariff socialisation and shared connection infrastructure.

GR · Law 5215/2025 · July 2025

Greece

Partial transposition establishes hydrogen-market rules and a shared cost-allocation approach for biomethane connections.

De-risking & cost allocationPlanning / decommissioning
DE · Draft law · EnWG-Novelle 2026

Germany

The draft law combines development and decommissioning planning and allows regional clustering among network operators.

CZ · Draft amendment · Energy Act (Energetický zákon)

Czech Republic

The draft transposition law sets notice periods and differentiates planning requirements by DSO size.

IT · Legislative Decree No. 136 · 3 Jul 2026 · in force 15 Aug 2026

Italy

The final decree requires repurposing potential and system impacts to be assessed before relevant gas-network decommissioning.

Key takeaways
Member States are using different legal and regulatory routes. The examples span early hydrogen-network organisation, tariff and connection-cost allocation, and rules for repurposing and decommissioning existing gas networks.Beyond the EU: Norway (EEA – Gas Package incorporation under scrutiny) · United Kingdom (non-EU – own framework in Great Britain)
Source: Ready4H2 · Overview of National Approaches to Gas Package Implementation · 30 Sep 2026 · Illustrative, non-exhaustive national examples.
